verdict.rationale: Zero calls itself 'an open-source AI email solution', and its source is publicly hosted at github.com/Mail-0/Zero, including readable repo files such as CONTRIBUTING.md, ROADMAP.md and MCP.md on the staging branch. It is also positioned for self-hosting, so the source is readable and usable. Missing for 10: the specific open-source license is never named or quoted in the evidence, and there is no independent confirmation of the license terms.
